nodes.name: Preparation of alpha-Co(OH)2
nodes.procedure: Ammonia water (2 mL, 25%) was added to a solution of Co(NO3)2 (240 mL, 0.05 M), the mixture was stirred for 5 min. The green blue precipitate was washed by centrifugation and transferred to a Teflon-lined autoclave with a water/methanol (32 mL / 32 mL) mixture, then heated at 180 °C for 30 min.

unit_operations.name: Precipitation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Ammonia water (2 mL, 25%) was added to a solution of Co(NO3)2 (240 mL, 0.05 M), the mixture was stirred for 5 min

unit_operations.name: Hydrothermal treatment
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: transferred into a 100 mL Teflon-lined autoclave, which was filled with solvents (water/methanol, 32 mL / 32 mL)... heated at 180 °C for 30 min

nodes.source_text: Ammonia water (2 mL, 25%) was added ... heated at 180 °C for 30 min to obtain colloidal solution of α·-Co(OH)2

nodes.name: Preparation of beta-Co(OH)2/rGO
nodes.procedure: GO solution (10 mL, 9.6 mg) and alpha-Co(OH)2 colloidal solution (100 mL, 96 mg) were mixed via ultrasonic (30 min), then hydrazine monohydrate (0.32 mL) was added. The mixture was refluxed at 95 °C for 24 h. The product was collected, washed, and dispersed in DMF.

unit_operations.name: Dispersion
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: dispersed in DMF to the concentration of 3 mg mL^-1

nodes.source_text: graphene oxide solution ... subsequently refluxed at 95 °C for 24 h. Afterwards... dispersed in DMF to the concentration of 3 mg mL^-1

nodes.name: Preparation of CoPGT electrode
nodes.procedure: Ti fiber felt was soaked in the beta-Co(OH)2/rGO solution, followed by drying. Repeat this process multiple times. Then the precursor and 500 mg of NaH2PO2 were placed in a tube furnace and phosphorized at 350 °C for 2 h at a heating rate of 10 °C min^-1 under N2 flow.

unit_operations.name: Infiltration
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Ti fiber felt (TF) was thoroughly soaked in the above solution of β·Co(OH)2/rGO hybrid

unit_operations.name: Phosphorization
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: phosphorization at 350 °C for 2 h at a heating rate of 10 °C min^-1 under the flow of N2.

nodes.source_text: Ti fiber felt (TF) was thoroughly soaked in the above solution of β·Co(OH)2/rGO hybrid ... phosphorization at 350 °C for 2 h

nodes.name: Preparation of beta-Co(OH)2
nodes.procedure: The preparation process for β·Co(OH)2 was similar to that for β·Co(OH)2/rGO except addition of graphene oxide. Colloidal solution of α-Co(OH)2 was mixed with hydrazine and refluxed at 95 °C for 24 h.
nodes.source_text: preparation process for β·Co(OH)2 was similar to that for β·Co(OH)2/rGO except addition of graphene oxide

nodes.name: Preparation of CoPT electrode
nodes.procedure: Ti fiber felt was soaked in beta-Co(OH)2 solution (without graphene oxide), dried, and then phosphorized with NaH2PO2 at 350 °C for 2 h under N2 flow.
nodes.source_text: CoP@TF, Co3O4/rGO(a)TF materials were also prepared with the same method without the addition of graphene oxide, NaH2PO2, respectively.

nodes.name: Preparation of Co3O4GT electrode
nodes.procedure: Ti fiber felt was soaked in the beta-Co(OH)2/rGO solution and dried. The sample was prepared without the addition of NaH2PO2 (implied air annealing or simple drying).
nodes.source_text: Co3O4/rGO(a)TF materials were also prepared with the same method without the addition of ... NaH2PO2

nodes.name: Preparation of CoP Powder
nodes.procedure: The beta-Co(OH)2 was freeze-dried, followed by phosphorization to obtain CoP powder.

unit_operations.name: Freeze Drying
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: afterwards collected by centrifugation, washed 3 times with DI water, and then freeze-dry

unit_operations.name: Phosphorization
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: followed by phosphorization to obtained CoP powder.

nodes.source_text: freeze-dry, followed by phosphorization to obtained CoP powder.

nodes.description: Standard HER performance in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: The as-prepared CoPGT catalyst... required only a small overpotential of 103 mV at the current density of 10 mA cm−2... Even when the current density increased to as high as 200 mA cm−2, the as-prepared catalyst can also realize a low overpotential of 210 mV... CoPGT exhibits a Tafel slopes of 66.1 mV dec−1.

nodes.description: Salinity tolerance in NaCl and sea salt electrolytes
nodes.source_text: Chronopotentiometry curves of CoPGT at 10 mA cm−2 in 1.0 M KOH with 0.6 M NaCl, saturated NaCl, 0.6 M sea salt and saturated sea salt... overpotential increase was < 28 mV at 10 mA cm−2 from 0 M to saturated chloride sodium.
The electrode durability was tested by the galvanostatic method, which was conducted at 10 mA cm−2 for 60 hours... after 10000 cycles... overpotential is increased by only 10 mV.
the dissolution rate of Co element in the electrolyte with 0.6 M NaCl is only about 0.04%, which is really quite negligible.

nodes.description: Intrinsic activity and active surface area evaluation
nodes.source_text: The CoP/rGO had a higher Cdl of 2.33 mF cm−2 than CoP... The TOF of CoP/rGO is 0.0239 s−1, indicating a high intrinsic activity.

The Faraday efficiency (ε) of HER was determined by measuring the amount of H2 produced... measured using gas chromatography... The Faradaic efficiency tests were performed in a two-electrode system... The CoPGT catalyst and Pt foil were used as the counter electrode (CE) and reference electrode (RE), respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows dense coverage of CoP/rGO nanoplates on Ti fiber for CoPGT; Co3O4GT and CoPT exhibit a similar frame structure.
nodes.evidence_snippet: scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images of CoPGT catalyst ... Co3O4GT and CoPT catalysts were prepared for comparison ... Both of them present a similar frame structure with CoPGT.

Shows a highly magnified view of a layered or porous material structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM shows CoP/rGO as wrinkled, multi-layer sheets; HRTEM reveals lattice fringes of 0.231 nm and 0.164 nm for (201) and (020) planes of CoP; SAED confirms polycrystalline nature.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM image, HRTEM image and electron diffraction pattern of CoP/rGO ... lattice fringes of 0.231 nm and 0.164 nm ... agreeing well with d-spacing values of the (201) and (020) planes of CoP

properties.description: Shows nanoscale, thin, crumpled, sheet-like structures.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD confirms the CoP phase for CoP/rGO (with trace Co2P) and validates the Co3O4 phase for the Co3O4GT catalyst.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD pattern of CoP/rGO ... indexed to the ... crystal planes of CoP phase ... XRD pattern and XPS spectra of Co3O4GT in Supplementary Fig. 12 confirm that the oxidized Co species is attributed to Co3O4.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms the valence states of Co and P in CoPGT and verifies that the oxidized species in Co3O4GT is Co3O4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: peaks at binding energies of 779.6 eV and 795.1 eV are assigned to Co with a partial positive charge for CoP ... XRD pattern and XPS spectra of Co3O4GT ... confirm that the oxidized Co species is attributed to Co3O4.

properties.note: The '2 Theta (degree)' label on the top axis is inconsistent with XPS data (which measures binding energy in eV) and is likely a mislabeling in the original figure.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nitrogen adsorption-desorption shows the surface area of CoP/rGO is more than double that of pure CoP, with a higher pore volume.
nodes.evidence_snippet: BET surface area of CoP/rGO is higher than double that of pure CoP powder ... BJH pore-size distribution curve of CoP/rGO shows a higher pore volume

nodes.characterization_summary: Cyclic voltammetry reveals a double-layer capacitance (Cdl) of 2.33 mF/cm^2 for CoP/rGO, indicating more exposed active surface area compared to pure CoP.
nodes.evidence_snippet: double-layer capacitances (Cdl) measurements were carried out ... CoP/rGO had a higher Cdl of 2.33 mF cm^-2 than CoP

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS analysis shows CoP/rGO has a smaller charge-transfer resistance (Rct) value than pure CoP, suggesting enhanced charge transfer kinetics.
nodes.evidence_snippet: CoP/rGO catalyst presented a smaller Rct value than CoP, implying faster charge transfer.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS confirms high corrosion resistance for CoPGT with a low Co dissolution rate of 0.04%, significantly lower than the 2.37% dissolution rate of Pt in commercial Pt/C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: dissolution rate of Co element in the electrolyte with 0.6 M NaCl is only about 0.04% ... dissolution rate of Pt element reach up to 2.37%

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS mapping demonstrates uniform distribution of Co, P, and C in CoPGT, Co3O4GT, and CoP/rGO, while Co and P are uniform in CoPT.
nodes.evidence_snippet: elemental mapping images further reveal that Co, P, and C elements are uniformly distributed on the Ti fiber surface ... mapping images show the Co3O4GT with uniform distribution of Co, P, and C elements and the CoPT with uniform distribution of Co and P ... elemental mapping images of CoP/rGO clearly evidence that Co, P, C elements are well-dispersed

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrical conductivity of the catalyst powders (CoP/rGO and pure CoP) was measured using a four-probe tester on pressed pellets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The conductivity is measured with a four-probe tester ... in which CoP/rGO powder and CoP powder are pressed into thin slices.
